item.title: Treasury cancels all Booz Allen contracts
item.description: The cancellations are tied to a former Booz Allen employee, who admitted two years ago to leaking President Trump's tax information and tax data on other wealthy individuals.

item.title: OMB reverses Biden-era software attestation order
item.description: A new executive branch memorandum instead allows agencies to lean on software bills of materials, or SBOMs, in lieu of a universal attestation framework.

item.title: Salesforce signs $5.5B contract with the Army
item.description: The vehicle will be open to the entire Defense Department and broadens access to the company’s artificial intelligence, data and cloud technologies over the next 10 years.

item.title: National Weather Service’s AI translation project lacks long-term plan, watchdog says
item.description: A new report from the Government Accountability Office warned that the weather agency “has not developed a long-term plan for the AI translation project because of current uncertainty on how the project will fit into broader NWS efforts.”

item.title: Suspected Chinese spies targeted former State official for Venezuela research
item.description: The recruitment scheme involved a sham company previously reported by Nextgov/FCW that has sought out former U.S. federal employees through fake websites and job postings.

item.title: Watch for GenAI browsers, purple teaming and evolving AI policy in 2026
item.description: COMMENTARY | Government IT leaders cannot afford inaction, especially as AI adoption accelerates.

item.title: Senators demand details on DOGE’s data access following revelations of improperly shared SSA data
item.description: While Sens. Michael Crapo, R-Idaho, and Ron Wyden, D-Ore., are asking for more information from SSA, Democrats in the lower chamber want to compel the agency to hand it over using a “resolution of inquiry.”

item.title: Bipartisan pair of senators acknowledge need for federal AI standard that accounts for state laws
item.description: Sens. Cantwell and Young sound off on the policy requirements the U.S. needs to strengthen its scientific enterprise to win the global AI race.

item.title: Building government resilience in an era of AI-driven cyberattacks
item.description: COMMENTARY | As AI reshapes cyber threats, resilience will hinge on speed.

item.title: US developed ‘non-kinetic’ cell ahead of Venezuela mission to push cyber operations
item.description: Officials said that cyber capabilities are expected to play a central role in future U.S. military undertakings.
